title: Person stirring latte art in a cup
notes: Close-up of a hand idly stirring a latte in a mint-green cup on a saucer at a wooden cafe table; from ~7 s the other hand rests on the cup handle at right, at ~10 s the spoon lifts and drips foam, then stirs again. Reads as the awkward pause: fidgeting with the cup while there is nothing to say. Hands only, no face (slim hands, gender not obvious). The latte-art swan is already broken up by 7 s, so it does not look cheerful. Soft daylight, warm, medium brightness (not dark): darken/desaturate a little to match the dim cafe photos. No text or logos (the patterned paper mat at the left edge is only colour). One continuous take, 19.2 s.

title: A romantic date in a cafe abroad
notes: Cafe terrace seen through foreground plants: a woman (long brown hair, camel corduroy jacket, close to the date partner's camel cardigan) smiles at a man in a grey knit seen from behind / three-quarter rear (curly, collar-length hair; his face is not shown). Slow camera truck to the right. 1.5-2.5 s he is still, ~2.75-3.75 s he moves his head and leans in as if starting to answer = 'hesitates, then answers'. The woman's face is visible in profile (she is the partner, not the protagonist). BRIGHT daylight, pink window frames and green leaves: darken and desaturate strongly. No text or logos; thin white swing ropes cross the frame. Continuous take, 16.1 s.

title: Walking in the city at night seeing its buildings
notes: COMPROMISE: no Free clip of a man on a night bus/subway or walking alone at night exists (25251, 47988, 47203, 21841, 22243, 27717, 28096 are Restricted; the Free bus clips 42574/42570 are neon fashion shoots; ep3 hit the same wall). This is a slow POV walk at blue hour/night past dark trees, a street lamp (enters ~6.4 s) and lit high-rise towers, with no person: reads as his walk home at night right after P10 (him walking home). Dark, cool blue, cinematic, usable as is. A small multicolour corporate logo sits high on a distant tower at the right edge (x 1756-1784, y 486-531 during 3.4-6.0 s; hidden behind trees 6.25-8.25 s), so blur_box. The lit spire on the left tower is a plain lattice (no lettering); construction crane at left. Continuous take, 9.3 s.

title: Hand of an artist with a brush when painting
notes: Close-up of a hand painting a purple watercolour wash with a fine brush, warm low lamp light raking across the paper, dark background: someone absorbed in a hobby at home in the evening ('something you do without being told'), and it leads straight into P13 (him drawing at an easel). Hands only (an older-looking hand), no face, no text. Warm and fairly dim, close to the desk-lamp photos; usable as is. Steady single take, 10.3 s.

title: A young man sitting in a dark room focuses on the unfolding chess game
notes: Dark, cinematic: a bearded man (dark slicked-back hair, black turtleneck) sits in a dim room with bookshelves, looking down with a finger pressed to his temple (3.4-6.2 s), then lowers the hand and keeps staring down: literal 'then he thinks'. The chess board in the title is never in frame. FACE CLEARLY VISIBLE (three-quarter front), not the protagonist's look: it is sharp only under the first, bottom subtitle (~1.2 s); the next two lines are centre subtitles (blurred). No text or logos (book spines dark and unreadable). FILE IS 1280x720: mk.py only reaches the 720p asset for this item. Alt 25581 (silhouette, no face) is used by group B for st12 at 4.0-12.6 s; st05 could take 0.0-4.1 s of it without overlap if a faceless shot is preferred.

title: A woman gently turning the pages of a book
notes: Close-up of a thick, dense-text book open on a lap (jeans); a hand turns pages at ~1.7-2.8 s and comes in again at ~7 s: 'looking into the research'. Warm, soft, medium-dim. Page text is small French body text, upside-down to the viewer and mostly out of focus; no titles or logos (same kind of page print ep3 accepted for 1724); soften slightly if wanted. Do not run past ~10 s (the book then opens on painted art plates with nudes). Hands only. The magnifier clip 13807 shows readable English text and the library-spine clip 50726 was dropped in the burnout episode for readable titles, so neither is used.

title: Watering plants in a garden
notes: Low close shot of a lime-green watering can pouring onto small young plants in a dark soil bed; the pour runs ~2.3-10.9 s while the can moves along the row. Literal 'growing a small interest' (watering a young plant), and it echoes the owner's sprout-in-a-pot photo (photo 42). No people (a shoe tip at the right edge, ~x1880 y360-390), no text. BRIGHT daytime garden, saturated green: darken and desaturate. Indoor sprout/watering clips are all Restricted (33570, 33422, 47063, 46091, 47540, 14879, 9762, 45360, 33337, 47062, 47064, 47080, 47273, 46092, 47886, 14882, 14883, 32169, 25408, 34684, 6894). Continuous take, 13.4 s.

title: Drawing in a notebook on a white table
notes: A man's hands (dark shirt, smartwatch; face out of frame) drawing in a spiral sketchbook with a black marker at a white table: protagonist-like stand-in, slow camera truck. It shows the drawing but no visible struggle (every Free-licence check of pencil-face-sketching / erasing clips failed: 14956, 47164, 13339, 13326, 14683, 14693, 36721, 30232, 9339, 15136, 21489, 48519 Restricted; 2858 was used in ep3). Neutral indoor light, medium: darken/warm toward the desk-lamp photos. Small brand print on the pencils in the tray ('KE' mark, barcode, grade marks): at 2.5 s it sits at x 1130-1400, y 540-680 and drifts right ~75 px/s until the tray leaves frame (~12 s), so the static blur_box is the union; a keyframed box of ~420x190 following the tray is enough. The marker on the table is out of focus and unreadable. Same shoot as group B's st11 pick 29983 (high angle, same man and triangle sketch), which works as the 'drawing scene from before' callback. Continuous take, 12.3 s.

title: A young student with a black pen draws a mathematical chart on his squared notebook.
notes: All-centre segment (blurred and darkened), so mood/subject only: a warm, dim night-desk shot. Hands draw with a black pen on squared paper beside an open book, then the camera tilts up to a young man in a cream hoodie bent over the desk (face visible from ~4 s, looking down). Still at the desk over his paper at night, continuing from P26 (head down on the desk) and matching the desk-lamp photos. Small 'artisan...' print on the hoodie chest and the textbook print are unreadable once blurred (a blur_box is needed only if shown sharp). Thin margin: the clip is 9.34 s, span 0.3-9.1. Same actor as ep3's 50110/50126/50133, but a different clip. My first choice, 25581 (dejected silhouette), is already used by group B for st12 at 4.0-12.6 s.
